name: Galați
source: ANCPI Geoportal cadastral parcel service and OCPI Galați / ANCPI cadastral-program records

queries.query: Galati Romania cadastral map parcel Geoportal official cadastru ANCPI
queries.result: Found the official ANCPI property viewer, the ANCPI CP/CP_View ArcGIS REST service catalog, and official Galați cadastral-program records. The service metadata advertises a Cadastral Parcel layer with JSON/GeoJSON query support and CRS EPSG:4258.

queries.query: Galati Romania harta cadastrala parcele geoportal oficial ANCPI OCPI Galati
queries.result: Found the official ANCPI property viewer, OCPI Galați cadastral-office/program material, and the official sector-status PDF identifying Galați UAT cadastral sectors and their work status. No public city-specific downloadable parcel dataset was verified.

officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official viewer says it displays limits of registered properties/buildings and supports search by address, county/UAT and cadastral/land-book references; it is not advertised as an open bulk-download API.
Indexed ArcGIS REST metadata exposes Cadastral Parcel layer 1, query operations, JSON/GeoJSON formats, max record count 1000, and spatial reference EPSG:4258.
